title: An Integrative Nomogram for Identifying Early-Stage Parkinson's Disease Using Non-motor Symptoms and White Matter-Based Radiomics Biomarkers From Whole-Brain MRI
summary: An ML nomogram combined white-matter MRI radiomics and nonmotor symptoms to identify early PD; it was evaluated on held-out PPMI subjects and a 58-person SWEDD verification group. This is retrospective diagnostic evidence, not a clinical-outcome claim. Methods: PPMI 336 subjects (168 PD), random training/test split, white-matter MRI radiomics plus nonmotor symptoms, ML nomogram; independent SWEDD set n=58. Results report AUC 0.937 training, 0.922 testing, 0.836 SWEDD verification.
